server.description: Safe-by-default SQL guardrails for AI agents: AST-checked queries, per-table policy, audit log.
server.title: Midplane

environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string the agent's queries run against. Give it a least-privilege role: Midplane constrains what SQL is allowed, it does not widen or narrow what the role itself can reach.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a policy YAML granting per-table read/read_write access, tenant scoping, and column masking. Omit for the safe default: reads allowed, writes and DDL denied. Generate one with `npx midplane init`.
environmentVariables.name: MIDPLANE_POLICY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Where the local SQLite audit log is written. Defaults to ~/.midplane/audit.db; read it back with `midplane audit denies`.
environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable anonymous usage telemetry (DO_NOT_TRACK=1 also works). Never includes SQL, table or column names, or identifiers.
environmentVariables.name: MIDPLANE_TELEMETRY

environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string the agent's queries run against. Pass it with --env-file, never with an inline -e: a DSN on the docker command line leaks the password to `ps aux` and your shell history.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path (inside the container) to a policy YAML granting per-table read/read_write access, tenant scoping, and column masking. Omit for the safe default: reads allowed, writes and DDL denied.
environmentVariables.name: MIDPLANE_POLICY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Port the Streamable HTTP transport binds. Must match the url above if changed.
environmentVariables.name: PORT
